limitations: This game-specific implementation remains inside the GPL-2.0-or-later Warzone extension boundary.
Read only. Writing an image list back is not implemented.

`.img` is a heavily reused extension, so matching is scoped by path as well: `**/images/*.img` and `**/mods/**/*.img`. A mod that puts an image list anywhere else will not be prefiltered, which is deliberate — claiming every `.img` on disk would be worse.
Sprites are resolved but not read. `spritePath` is `<list path minus extension>/<name>`, which is how `iV_LoadImageFile` derives it; whether that PNG exists is the host's question.
The engine bin-packs the listed sprites onto texture pages at load time (`ImageMerge::arrange`). Page assignment, atlas coordinates and page count are runtime products and are not reconstructed here.

The pre-atlas eight-field record form (`page,x,y,w,h,xOffset,yOffset,"name"`), still shipped in `intfac_differentOil.img`, is reported as `warzone-img-legacy-atlas-record` rather than parsed. No loader in Warzone 2100 4.7.0 reads it: the engine's scanset stops at the third field, yielding a truncated name that then fails to open.

The engine sizes its image vector from the count of `\n` bytes while its parse loop runs to end-of-buffer, so a final line without a trailing newline disagrees with that count. The mismatch is surfaced as `imageCountMismatch` rather than imitated.
